Kisah Rama Kecil Sampai Menikahi Sinta: Ramayana Part 2
Rama Mematahkan Busur Siwa: Pangeran Kesayangan Seluruh Kota
meta.pilar: Pilar 6: Dark History & Unusual Science (sejarah, naskah, dan tradisi; dikerjakan sebagai catatan kepercayaan)
peta_3_poin: Dan kenapa seluruh kota begitu percaya padanya.
analogi: Rama seperti atasan yang hafal kabar timnya (S37)

walmiki_bk.atribusi: Valmiki Ramayana, Balakanda (terjemahan Inggris di sanskritdocuments.org/valmikiramayan.net; Sanskerta + terjemahan modern, hanya diparafrasekan)
walmiki_bk.catatan: Sarga 15, 16, 18, 26, 49, 67, 75 dibaca; sarga 19-22, 73, 76 tidak terbuka. Penomoran sarga mengikuti situs ini (Griffith memakai penomoran canto sendiri).

griffith.atribusi: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Ramayan of Valmiki translated into English verse (Book I-II)
griffith.catatan: Terjemahan 1870-74, domain publik. Canto XIX, XX, XXII, XXVIII, XXIX, XXXII, XLIX, LXVI, LXVII, LXXIII; Book II Canto I-IV dibaca. Cermin sacred-texts.com; edisi Gutenberg #24869 tidak terbuka.

wiki_balakanda.catatan: Ringkasan isi dan catatan sarjana (Goldman). Ensiklopedia daring, dipakai bersama sumber lain.

wiki_rama.catatan: Awatara Wisnu, Rama Nawami, masa muda, penanggalan (Brockington, Sankalia).

wiki_ramayana.catatan: Penanggalan Goldman, kitab tertua, Bala dan Uttara kanda tambahan, Kakawin, Ramakien, Prambanan.

clay_intro.atribusi: Pengantar Ramayana Book I: Boyhood, Clay Sanskrit Library (penulis tidak dipastikan dari kutipan yang terbaca)
clay_intro.catatan: Pandangan sarjana tentang Balakanda sebagai tambahan (Jacobi, Holtzmann, Bulcke, Tiwari); bagian petualangan awal Rama mungkin tua.

wiki_kakawin.catatan: Abad ke-9; Robson: antara 856 dan sekitar 930; sumber kemungkinan Bhattikavya.

wiki_sita.catatan: Asal Sinta di Walmiki (alur bajak); versi Jain, Adbhuta, wayang Jawa (putri Rahwana).

asianethnology.atribusi: Artikel Asian Ethnology tentang Sita sebagai putri Rahwana (menyebut Serat Kanda, Stutterheim 1925)
asianethnology.catatan: Hanya satu kalimat tentang Serat Kanda; detail tidak dipakai.

wiki_ramakien.catatan: Sida putri Totsakan, diadopsi Janaka; versi baku sekitar 1797-1807.

berkala_prambanan.atribusi: Berkala Arkeologi (BRIN), artikel relief Ramayana Candi Siwa dan Candi Brahma
berkala_prambanan.catatan: 24 panel Candi Siwa, 30 panel Candi Brahma; terbaca searah jarum jam.

photodharma.atribusi: Photo Dharma, Rama's Story, relief Prambanan (PhD Rama)
photodharma.catatan: Panel Siwa 01-07: Wiswamitra, Tataka, busur Siwa, Parasurama, persiapan penobatan. Situs penulis perorangan; dibaca hati-hati.

bl_blog.atribusi: British Library, Asian and African studies blog: The Ramayana in Southeast Asia 4
bl_blog.catatan: Relief Prambanan sekitar 900 M; Kakawin berbasis Bhattikavya; Hikayat Seri Rama.

walmiki_bk49.catatan: Ahalya tak terlihat sampai Rama datang; tidak menjadi batu.

wisdom_bala.atribusi: Wisdomlib, The Ramayana of Valmiki (Bala dan Atibala)

scenes.vo: Dewa penjaga semesta bisa jadi apa saja. Tapi dalam kitab Ramayana, ia memilih lahir sebagai manusia. Bisa lapar, bisa lelah, bisa terluka. Kenapa?
scenes.kamera: very slow push-in from the cosmic ocean toward Vishnu's calm face, then a gentle tilt down to the blue Earth
scenes.flow_subject: A majestic cosmic vision: the god Vishnu, serene, four-armed, deep blue skin, golden crown, reclining on the coiled many-headed celestial serpent on a shimmering ocean of stars, looking down toward a small glowing blue Earth where a tiny golden city twinkles
scenes.cam_en: very slow push-in from the cosmic ocean toward Vishnu's calm face, then a gentle tilt down to the blue Earth
scenes.beat1: stars drift and the ocean of light ripples softly; the serpent hoods sway almost imperceptibly
scenes.beat2: Vishnu gently lowers his gaze toward the blue Earth with a faint calm smile
scenes.beat3: the little golden city on the blue Earth glows brighter; hold on a calm final frame

scenes.vo: Ingat Rahwana, raja raksasa di bagian pertama? Ia meminta kebal dari dewa dan raksasa. Manusia ia anggap terlalu lemah untuk disebut. Di situlah celahnya.
scenes.kamera: slow dolly-in with a slight low angle on Rahwana
scenes.flow_subject: Inside a dark volcanic mountain throne hall, the ten-headed demon king Rahwana, ten crowned heads, red and gold robes, laughs proudly beside a glowing divine boon flame; at the foot of the steps a tiny lone human archer sits in a shaft of golden light
scenes.cam_en: slow dolly-in with a slight low angle on Rahwana
scenes.beat1: the boon flame flickers and Rahwana's shoulders shake with a quiet proud laugh, all ten crowned heads staying fixed in place
scenes.beat2: the camera drifts down toward the tiny lone human archer sitting at the foot of the steps as the shaft of golden light on him strengthens
scenes.beat3: the small archer stays lit by the warm shaft of light while the throne hall dims a little; hold

scenes.vo: Para dewa pun mengadu. Menurut Walmiki, penyair kitab ini, Dewa Wisnu bersedia turun sebagai manusia. Putra seorang raja. Namanya kelak Rama.
scenes.kamera: slow crane up through the clouds toward Vishnu
scenes.flow_subject: Heavenly court above golden clouds: a group of worried gods with soft halos bow with folded hands before Vishnu, who raises one hand in gentle blessing while the great eagle Garuda spreads golden wings behind him
scenes.cam_en: slow crane up through the clouds toward Vishnu
scenes.beat1: clouds roll gently and the bowing gods lower their heads a little more
scenes.beat2: Vishnu raises his blessing hand; soft golden light spreads from his palm
scenes.beat3: Garuda's wings settle slowly; hold on Vishnu's serene smile

scenes.vo: Kita akan jawab tiga hal. Bagaimana Rama lahir dan tumbuh. Apa yang menguji kekuatannya. Dan kenapa seluruh kota begitu percaya padanya.
scenes.kamera: slow arc of about fifteen degrees around Rama
scenes.flow_subject: Triptych-like single composition: Rama standing centre on a hilltop at dawn, behind him in soft light the golden city of Ayodhya on the left, a dark mysterious forest in the middle distance, and a distant royal hall with a giant bow on the right
scenes.cam_en: slow arc of about fifteen degrees around Rama
scenes.beat1: morning wind moves his sash and hair; birds cross far away
scenes.beat2: golden light sweeps across the city, then the forest mist drifts
scenes.beat3: the distant hall with the bow catches light; Rama looks calmly ahead; hold

scenes.vo: Satu catatan jujur dulu. Banyak sarjana menilai kitab pertama Walmiki ditambahkan belakangan. Jadi masa kecil Rama ini kisah tradisi, bukan sejarah yang terbukti.
scenes.kamera: slow macro push-in toward the palm leaf
scenes.flow_subject: A quiet ancient scriptorium at night: weathered palm-leaf manuscripts with abstract unreadable marks spread on a low wooden table, an old scholar's hands gently lifting one separate fresher leaf apart from the older stack, oil lamp glow, shelves of manuscript bundles
scenes.cam_en: slow macro push-in toward the palm leaf
scenes.beat1: the lamp flame wavers and dust motes float
scenes.beat2: the old hands lift the fresher leaf a little and set it gently apart
scenes.beat3: the hands rest; light settles on the older stack; hold

scenes.vo: Cerita dimulai di Ayodhya, ibu kota kerajaan Kosala. Rajanya, Dasarata, punya istana megah dan tiga permaisuri. Tapi ada satu yang kosong: ia belum punya putra.
scenes.kamera: slow dolly from the empty cradle to Dasarata and the city
scenes.flow_subject: Dasarata stands alone on a palace balcony at golden hour overlooking the splendid city of Ayodhya with white towers, gardens and the Sarayu river; beside him an empty small golden cradle, melancholic expression
scenes.cam_en: slow dolly from the empty cradle to Dasarata and the city
scenes.beat1: curtains and robes move in a soft breeze
scenes.beat2: Dasarata turns his eyes from the city down to the cradle
scenes.beat3: he lays one hand on the cradle rim and it rocks once; hold

scenes.vo: Atas saran penasihatnya, sang raja mengundang Resyasringa, seorang pertapa muda. Ia memimpin upacara api yang besar, khusus untuk memohon lahirnya putra.
scenes.kamera: steady slow push-in toward the fire altar
scenes.flow_subject: A grand outdoor fire ritual courtyard: a young gentle sage with a small single horn on his forehead, simple white cloth, pours ghee into a large square sacrificial fire while Dasarata and three queens in colourful saris sit with folded hands, priests, marigold garlands
scenes.cam_en: steady slow push-in toward the fire altar
scenes.beat1: flames dance and marigold garlands sway
scenes.beat2: the young sage pours a thin stream of ghee and the fire rises
scenes.beat3: queens and king bow their heads; sparks rise; hold

scenes.vo: Dari kobaran api, muncul sosok bercahaya membawa bejana emas. Isinya bubur suci. Hadiah dari para dewa, katanya, untuk para permaisuri.
scenes.kamera: slow tilt up following the rising being of light
scenes.flow_subject: From the roaring sacred fire rises a radiant tall celestial being made of warm golden light, offering a shining golden vessel of white sweet rice pudding with both hands to the astonished king Dasarata who kneels
scenes.cam_en: slow tilt up following the rising being of light
scenes.beat1: the flames swell and the radiant figure rises smoothly from them
scenes.beat2: he extends the golden vessel forward toward the kneeling king
scenes.beat3: Dasarata reaches out and both hands meet the vessel; hold

scenes.vo: Separuh bubur untuk Kausalya. Sisanya dibagi untuk Sumitra dan Kaikeyi, dan Sumitra mendapat dua kali. Tak lama, ketiganya mengandung.
scenes.kamera: slow lateral slide from left to right across the three queens
scenes.flow_subject: In a candle-lit inner palace chamber Dasarata serves white pudding from the golden vessel into three silver bowls for three queens seated side by side: Kausalya in ivory, a second queen in emerald green, a third queen in sunset orange; the first bowl visibly the fullest
scenes.cam_en: slow lateral slide from left to right across the three queens
scenes.beat1: candle flames flicker; Dasarata tips the vessel gently
scenes.beat2: white pudding pours softly into the nearest silver bowl
scenes.beat3: the three queens lift their eyes with quiet hope; hold

scenes.vo: Di musim semi, Kausalya melahirkan Rama. Kaikeyi melahirkan Bharata. Sumitra melahirkan si kembar, Laksmana dan Satrugna. Satu istana, empat tangisan bayi.
scenes.kamera: slow glide forward past the four cradles
scenes.flow_subject: A joyful spring morning palace nursery: four newborn babies in four carved golden cradles arranged in a gentle arc, one baby with soft blue-tinged dusky skin in the front cradle, three queens smiling, flower petals falling through tall arches, blossoming trees outside
scenes.cam_en: slow glide forward past the four cradles
scenes.beat1: petals drift down through the arches and cradle silks move
scenes.beat2: the babies make tiny hand movements and the queens lean in smiling
scenes.beat3: the camera settles on the blue-tinged baby in front, soft warm light; hold

scenes.vo: Rama dan Laksmana tak terpisahkan. Menurut Walmiki, Rama susah tidur tanpa adiknya. Makanan enak pun tak ia sentuh, kalau Laksmana belum ada.
scenes.kamera: very slow push-in toward the sleeping boys
scenes.flow_subject: Night in a royal bedroom: two little princes with black hair sleep peacefully side by side on one large silk bed, little blue-tinged Rama in a yellow dhoti in front and little Lakshmana in a blue dhoti just behind him, a small candle and a plate of sweets on the side table, a full moon outside the arched balcony, rich curtains
scenes.cam_en: very slow push-in toward the sleeping boys
scenes.beat1: the candle flame flickers and the curtains breathe gently in the night breeze
scenes.beat2: the two boys' chests rise and fall slowly while they stay asleep in the same positions
scenes.beat3: both smile faintly in their sleep; hold

scenes.vo: Ada kisah unik dari Tulsidas, penyair India abad keenam belas. Seekor gagak, yang sebenarnya resi sakti, datang menonton Rama kecil bermain di halaman.
scenes.kamera: gentle low dolly toward the crow and the child
scenes.flow_subject: Sunny marble palace courtyard with fountain and mango trees: little Rama sitting on the floor playing, a glossy black crow with intelligent golden shimmering eyes lands a few steps away watching him, Kausalya smiling from a doorway
scenes.cam_en: gentle low dolly toward the crow and the child
scenes.beat1: the fountain sparkles and mango leaves rustle
scenes.beat2: the crow hops one step and tilts its head, eyes shimmering gold
scenes.beat3: little Rama looks up and giggles, reaching one hand slightly; hold

scenes.vo: Rama kecil mencoba menangkapnya. Gagak itu terbang jauh, sampai ke alam para dewa. Tapi tangan mungil Rama selalu tinggal sejengkal di belakangnya.
scenes.kamera: smooth tracking shot following the crow through the clouds
scenes.flow_subject: High above clouds in a glowing celestial sky: the black crow flies swiftly with wings spread while a giant softly translucent small child's hand of little Rama reaches just a few finger widths behind it, golden heavenly palaces far below
scenes.cam_en: smooth tracking shot following the crow through the clouds
scenes.beat1: clouds rush softly past as the crow beats its wings
scenes.beat2: the translucent child's hand glides after it, always staying the same short distance behind
scenes.beat3: golden palaces shrink below; both keep flying; hold the gap

scenes.vo: Lalu sang gagak masuk ke mulut Rama. Di dalamnya ia melihat matahari, bulan, dan semesta tak terhitung. Anak kecil itu menyimpan jagat raya.
scenes.kamera: slow floating zoom-out with a slight rotation
scenes.flow_subject: Surreal wondrous cosmic interior: the tiny black crow floating in deep space surrounded by countless spiralling galaxies, many suns and moons and miniature worlds, framed by the faint gentle glowing silhouette of a smiling child's face around the edges
scenes.cam_en: slow floating zoom-out with a slight rotation
scenes.beat1: galaxies turn slowly around the tiny crow
scenes.beat2: suns and moons drift past in layers of depth
scenes.beat3: the faint smiling child silhouette around the edges brightens softly; hold

scenes.vo: Rama tumbuh mahir memanah, berkuda, dan mengendalikan gajah. Ia juga belajar kitab suci. Kuat, tapi tenang. Pintar, tapi tidak suka pamer.
scenes.kamera: slow side dolly past Rama toward the target
scenes.flow_subject: Royal training ground at golden morning: teenage Rama draws his bow with perfect calm posture toward a distant target, behind him a decorated royal elephant and a white horse, instructors watching, banners fluttering
scenes.cam_en: slow side dolly past Rama toward the target
scenes.beat1: banners flutter; the elephant moves its ears; the horse flicks its tail
scenes.beat2: Rama holds a perfectly steady full draw, breathing calmly
scenes.beat3: he releases a single arrow that flies out toward the target; he stays composed; hold

scenes.vo: Suatu hari, resi Wiswamitra datang ke istana. Ritual sucinya terus diganggu raksasa suruhan Rahwana. Ia meminta satu bantuan: pinjamkan Rama.
scenes.kamera: slow push-in down the throne hall
scenes.flow_subject: Grand throne hall with tall carved pillars: Wiswamitra stands before the throne with staff raised in earnest request, Dasarata rising from his golden throne to welcome him, courtiers, shafts of daylight
scenes.cam_en: slow push-in down the throne hall
scenes.beat1: light shafts shimmer; courtiers shift slightly
scenes.beat2: Wiswamitra lifts his staff a little and speaks earnestly
scenes.beat3: Dasarata lowers his outstretched hand and joins his palms in welcome; hold

scenes.vo: Dasarata gemetar. Rama belum genap enam belas tahun. Sang raja menawarkan pasukannya, bahkan dirinya sendiri. Akhirnya Wasista, guru istana, meyakinkannya untuk melepas Rama.
scenes.kamera: slow push-in on the three faces
scenes.flow_subject: Throne hall close composition: anxious Dasarata with trembling hands on young Rama's shoulders, Rama looking back calmly, beside them a second elderly sage with a neat white beard and white robes, the royal priest Wasista, gently advising
scenes.cam_en: slow push-in on the three faces
scenes.beat1: Dasarata's hands tremble on Rama's shoulders
scenes.beat2: the white-robed priest leans in and speaks gently
scenes.beat3: Dasarata slowly lets go and nods; Rama bows his head calmly; hold

scenes.vo: Di tepi sungai Sarayu, Rama menerima dua mantra, Bala dan Atibala. Penangkal lelah, lapar, dan haus. Malam itu, pangeran istana tidur beralas rumput.
scenes.kamera: slow arc around the kneeling Rama
scenes.flow_subject: Blue hour by a wide sacred river: Wiswamitra seated teaching, Rama kneeling with closed eyes while soft two threads of golden light swirl around him, Lakshmana beside; a simple bed of grass nearby, fireflies, reeds, stars
scenes.cam_en: slow arc around the kneeling Rama
scenes.beat1: river ripples, fireflies drift, reeds sway
scenes.beat2: two soft threads of golden light circle Rama and enter his chest
scenes.beat3: the light fades into calm blue night, the grass bed in view; hold

scenes.vo: Lalu mereka memasuki hutan gelap milik Tataka. Dulu ia makhluk penjaga alam, lalu kutukan mengubahnya menjadi raksasi. Seluruh wilayah itu ditinggalkan warga.
scenes.kamera: slow forward tracking behind the three travellers
scenes.flow_subject: A vast eerie dark forest with twisted giant trees, broken abandoned village huts overgrown with vines, mist; Rama, Lakshmana and Wiswamitra walk cautiously on a path, huge shadowy footprints, a faint pair of amber eyes deep in the darkness
scenes.cam_en: slow forward tracking behind the three travellers
scenes.beat1: mist creeps between the trunks and leaves fall
scenes.beat2: the three step carefully along the path; Lakshmana looks around
scenes.beat3: two amber eyes glow once in the dark ahead and they stop; hold

scenes.vo: Rama ragu, sebab lawannya perempuan. Gurunya mengingatkan, melindungi rakyat adalah tugas. Rama menarik busurnya. Tataka tumbang, dan hutan itu bebas lagi.
scenes.kamera: slow dramatic push-in from Rama toward Tataka
scenes.flow_subject: Dramatic dusk clearing: Tataka looms large in swirling dust and leaves on one side, Rama on the other side stands firm with bow fully drawn and a glowing arrow tip, distance between them, heroic tension, no blood
scenes.cam_en: slow dramatic push-in from Rama toward Tataka
scenes.beat1: dust and leaves swirl; Tataka raises her arms but keeps her distance
scenes.beat2: Rama steadies the fully drawn bow and the arrow tip brightens
scenes.beat3: the arrow releases as a clean streak of light and the frame fills with soft golden glow; no impact shown

scenes.vo: Wiswamitra pun mewariskan senjata-senjata langit. Dalam kisahnya, senjata itu muncul bercahaya, lalu berjanji melayani Rama. Rama menerimanya dengan hormat.
scenes.kamera: slow upward spiral around Rama
scenes.flow_subject: Mountain clearing at sunrise: Wiswamitra raises his hands as a circle of radiant celestial weapons made of light, a spinning discus, a golden mace, a trident-like spear, glowing arrows, hover around Rama who receives them with folded hands
scenes.cam_en: slow upward spiral around Rama
scenes.beat1: dawn clouds drift and the sage's beard moves in the wind
scenes.beat2: the weapons of light orbit smoothly around Rama
scenes.beat3: Rama bows his head with joined palms as the lights gather into soft sparks; hold

scenes.vo: Kemudian Rama dan Laksmana menjaga ritual enam hari enam malam. Hampir tanpa tidur. Pada hari keenam, langit mendadak gelap. Marica dan Subahu menyerang.
scenes.kamera: slow pull-back revealing the sky
scenes.flow_subject: Forest hermitage at night turning stormy: sages seated around a sacred fire altar, Rama and Lakshmana stand guard back to back with bows, sky suddenly darkening with swirling purple storm clouds and two distant demon silhouettes approaching
scenes.cam_en: slow pull-back revealing the sky
scenes.beat1: altar flames flicker; the brothers keep watch, turning their heads
scenes.beat2: storm clouds swirl in and the light turns purple
scenes.beat3: two demon silhouettes grow larger in the clouds; the brothers raise their bows; hold

scenes.vo: Subahu gugur. Marica dihantam panah sakti, terlempar jauh ke tengah lautan, tapi selamat. Ingat namanya. Kita akan bertemu dia lagi.
scenes.kamera: fast-feeling but smooth wide pan following the arrow of light
scenes.flow_subject: Epic action wide shot: Rama releases a blazing blue-white arrow of energy that sweeps a large demon with curved horns away through the sky toward a distant stormy ocean on the horizon; hermitage fire below, no blood, no injury
scenes.cam_en: fast-feeling but smooth wide pan following the arrow of light
scenes.beat1: Rama releases the blazing arrow
scenes.beat2: the demon is carried away backward across the sky on the beam of light
scenes.beat3: he becomes a small glint far over the distant ocean; hold on Rama lowering his bow

scenes.vo: Dalam perjalanan, mereka singgah di pertapaan sunyi. Di sana Ahalya menjalani kutukan suaminya, seorang resi. Ia hidup menyepi, tak terlihat siapa pun.
scenes.kamera: slow cautious dolly through the hermitage entrance
scenes.flow_subject: Silent overgrown hermitage garden with a small abandoned hut, pale dried leaves and ash on the ground; Rama, Lakshmana and Wiswamitra arrive at the entrance; barely visible shimmering translucent outline of a seated woman meditating inside soft mist
scenes.cam_en: slow cautious dolly through the hermitage entrance
scenes.beat1: dry leaves tumble and mist breathes
scenes.beat2: the three travellers stop and look toward the shimmering outline
scenes.beat3: the outline glimmers a little brighter but remains translucent; hold

scenes.vo: Begitu Rama datang, Ahalya tampak kembali. Kedua pangeran menyentuh kakinya dengan hormat. Kutukan berakhir. Di cerita populer ia jadi batu, tapi Walmiki tidak begitu.
scenes.kamera: slow gentle push-in on Ahalya
scenes.flow_subject: The same hermitage now blooming with flowers: Ahalya, a serene woman in plain white sari, becomes visible in warm golden light as Rama and Lakshmana kneel respectfully touching her feet, petals falling from the sky
scenes.cam_en: slow gentle push-in on Ahalya
scenes.beat1: flowers open and petals begin to fall
scenes.beat2: Ahalya becomes fully visible in warm light while the brothers stay kneeling with hands at her feet
scenes.beat3: she opens her eyes and raises a hand in welcome; hold

scenes.vo: Di versi Tulsidas, ada momen manis di taman kerajaan Mithila. Rama sedang memetik bunga untuk gurunya. Sinta datang berdoa. Mata mereka bertemu.
scenes.kamera: slow lateral glide across the lotus pond
scenes.flow_subject: Lush royal garden in spring with a lotus pond with jewelled steps, peacocks, parrots and vine pavilions: Rama holding a basket of flowers on one side, Sinta with two friends arriving near a small white temple on the other side, their eyes meeting across the pond
scenes.cam_en: slow lateral glide across the lotus pond
scenes.beat1: peacocks step, parrots hop, water ripples
scenes.beat2: Sinta walks two gentle steps and lifts her eyes; Rama pauses with the flower basket
scenes.beat3: their eyes meet across the pond and both stay still; hold

scenes.vo: Siapa Sinta? Menurut Walmiki, Raja Janaka menemukannya sebagai bayi di alur tanah saat membajak. Nama Sinta sendiri berarti alur bajak.
scenes.kamera: slow low push-in along the furrow
scenes.flow_subject: Golden sunrise over a freshly ploughed field: Janaka kneels beside a wooden plough drawn by white oxen and gently lifts a glowing baby girl wrapped in rose cloth from the earth furrow, flowers sprouting around, attendants amazed
scenes.cam_en: slow low push-in along the furrow
scenes.beat1: oxen breathe and shift slightly, golden dust floats
scenes.beat2: Janaka lifts the wrapped baby gently from the soil
scenes.beat3: the baby moves a tiny hand and flowers sway around them; hold

scenes.vo: Janaka punya syarat. Sinta hanya untuk pria yang sanggup memasang tali pada busur Siwa. Banyak raja mencoba. Mengangkatnya saja mereka gagal.
scenes.kamera: slow push-in on the straining men and the giant bow
scenes.flow_subject: Immense royal hall: a colossal ornate ancient bow resting on a stone platform, several proud kings in colourful armour straining together and failing to lift it, Janaka watching from his seat
scenes.cam_en: slow push-in on the straining men and the giant bow
scenes.beat1: torch light flickers
scenes.beat2: the men strain with all their strength while the heavy bow only wobbles slightly
scenes.beat3: they sag and lower the bow back onto the stone platform; Janaka watches; hold

scenes.vo: Para raja yang malu lalu mengepung Mithila selama setahun. Janaka bertapa memohon bantuan. Para dewa mengirim pasukan, dan pengepungan itu bubar.
scenes.kamera: slow aerial drift toward the city
scenes.flow_subject: Wide aerial view of the walled city of Mithila surrounded by army camps with banners at dusk, while a luminous celestial army of golden warriors descends from the clouds scattering the camps; Janaka on a tower with folded hands in foreground
scenes.cam_en: slow aerial drift toward the city
scenes.beat1: campfire smoke and banners move
scenes.beat2: the golden celestial warriors descend as streams of light
scenes.beat3: army banners fall back and tents empty as the camps recede; Janaka lowers his folded hands; hold, no violence

scenes.vo: Kini giliran Rama. Busur itu dibawa dalam peti besi beroda delapan. Dalam kisahnya, lima ribu orang bertubuh kuat harus menariknya.
scenes.kamera: steady tracking beside the great chest
scenes.flow_subject: A huge iron chest on eight great wooden wheels being pulled by a long crowd of many strong men with thick ropes into a magnificent hall; Rama, Wiswamitra and Janaka waiting, onlookers on balconies
scenes.cam_en: steady tracking beside the great chest
scenes.beat1: the eight wheels roll slowly and heavily, ropes taut
scenes.beat2: the long line of men lean and pull in unison
scenes.beat3: the chest comes to a slow stop while Rama watches calmly from his place; hold

scenes.vo: Rama mengangkatnya, memasang tali, lalu menariknya. Busur itu patah. Suaranya seperti gunung runtuh. Hampir semua orang di balairung jatuh pingsan.
scenes.kamera: slow push-in, then one gentle shake at the break
scenes.flow_subject: The climactic moment: Rama standing centre bending the colossal bow which snaps in the middle with a burst of golden light and shockwave, courtiers around reeling and falling gently, Sinta watching from a balcony with amazed eyes, banners blown back
scenes.cam_en: slow push-in, then one gentle shake at the break
scenes.beat1: Rama bends the bow further, muscles steady
scenes.beat2: the bow snaps once in the middle with a burst of golden light
scenes.beat3: a soft shockwave moves banners and courtiers sink gently while Rama stands calm; hold

scenes.vo: Janaka menyerahkan Sinta, yang akan mendampingi Rama seperti bayangan. Di hari yang sama, ketiga adik Rama menikah. Empat pasangan mengelilingi api suci.
scenes.kamera: very slow push-in toward the sacred fire
scenes.flow_subject: Festive wedding pavilion at night: exactly four bridal couples with flower garlands around one sacred fire, Rama and Sinta as the nearest couple on the right, Lakshmana and the other couples around the fire, marigold garlands, lamps, guests seated far behind
scenes.cam_en: very slow push-in toward the sacred fire
scenes.beat1: flames and lamps flicker, petals drift down
scenes.beat2: the four couples take one or two small slow steps around the fire, staying paired and always exactly eight people with garlands
scenes.beat3: Rama and Sinta glance at each other with soft smiles; hold

scenes.vo: Pulang ke Ayodhya, rombongan dihadang Parasurama, resi pejuang berkapak. Ia menantang: kalau memang hebat, coba tarik busur Wisnu milikku.
scenes.kamera: slow push-in past the halted chariots to Parasurama
scenes.flow_subject: Mountain road with a wedding procession of chariots and elephants halted: Parasurama blocks the way, axe on shoulder, holding out a great divine bow toward Rama, wind and dust, dramatic clouds
scenes.cam_en: slow push-in past the halted chariots to Parasurama
scenes.beat1: wind blows dust, clouds race slowly
scenes.beat2: Parasurama steps forward and holds out the great bow
scenes.beat3: Rama turns to face him calmly and reaches one hand toward the bow; hold

scenes.vo: Rama menariknya dengan mudah. Tapi ia tak mau memanah seorang resi. Panah itu diarahkan ke pahala tapanya. Parasurama mengakui Rama, lalu pergi ke gunung.
scenes.kamera: slow tilt from Rama's face up along the arrow to the sky
scenes.flow_subject: Rama holds the great divine bow fully drawn with a radiant arrow aimed upward toward a glowing golden heavenly realm in the sky, Parasurama beside him bowing his head humbly with palms joined
scenes.cam_en: slow tilt from Rama's face up along the arrow to the sky
scenes.beat1: the arrow tip glows and wind moves their hair
scenes.beat2: the arrow rises as a streak of light into the golden heavenly realm, which dissolves into soft sparks
scenes.beat3: Parasurama bows deeper with joined palms; hold

scenes.vo: Lalu apa rahasia Rama? Menurut Walmiki, ia menyapa lebih dulu dan bicara lembut. Satu kebaikan orang ia syukuri. Banyak keburukan tidak ia simpan.
scenes.kamera: gentle walking dolly alongside Rama
scenes.flow_subject: Bright Ayodhya street morning: Rama smiling greets first an old potter and a flower-seller woman with folded hands, they smile back warmly, colourful market stalls, children
scenes.cam_en: gentle walking dolly alongside Rama
scenes.beat1: market awnings sway, children move
scenes.beat2: Rama greets first with joined palms
scenes.beat3: the potter and flower seller smile and return the greeting; hold

scenes.vo: Di sela latihan senjata, ia sempat duduk bersama orang tua dan orang bijak. Ia mau mendengar. Itu kekuatan yang jarang dimiliki orang kuat.
scenes.kamera: slow push-in under the banyan
scenes.flow_subject: Under a huge banyan tree in a palace garden at late afternoon: Rama sits on the ground listening attentively to three white-haired elders and sages, his bow and arrows set aside beside a practice target
scenes.cam_en: slow push-in under the banyan
scenes.beat1: leaves rustle and dappled light moves
scenes.beat2: an elder speaks with a slow hand gesture
scenes.beat3: Rama nods thoughtfully and keeps listening; hold

scenes.vo: Pada warga, ia bertanya soal keluarga dan pekerjaan mereka. Ikut sedih saat mereka susah. Seperti atasan yang hafal kabar timnya, tanpa dibuat-buat.
scenes.kamera: slow eye-level push-in on the family
scenes.flow_subject: Evening in a humble neighbourhood lane with oil lamps: Rama sits on a low step with a family of farmers, listening with concern, an elderly grandmother holding his hand, children peeking
scenes.cam_en: slow eye-level push-in on the family
scenes.beat1: oil lamps flicker, evening smoke drifts
scenes.beat2: the grandmother speaks and squeezes Rama's hand
scenes.beat3: Rama nods with concern, then gives a warm reassuring smile; hold

scenes.vo: Kisah ini juga hidup di Jawa. Di Candi Prambanan, sekitar abad kesembilan, relief batu memahat Wiswamitra, busur yang direntangkan, sampai Parasurama.
scenes.kamera: slow crane up from the relief panel to the temple towers
scenes.flow_subject: Prambanan temple compound in Java at golden sunset: tall volcanic stone temple towers, foreground close view of a weathered stone relief panel showing an archer drawing a great bow among carved figures, frangipani petals
scenes.cam_en: slow crane up from the relief panel to the temple towers
scenes.beat1: frangipani petals drift across the stone
scenes.beat2: sunset light slides over the carved archer; the carving stays completely still
scenes.beat3: the towers glow against the orange sky; hold

scenes.vo: Tiap tradisi punya rasa sendiri. Dalam sebagian cerita wayang Jawa, juga Ramakien dari Thailand, Sinta justru disebut putri Rahwana yang dibesarkan keluarga lain.
scenes.kamera: slow pan from the shadow puppet to the golden mask
scenes.flow_subject: Elegant split-light composition: on the left a Javanese wayang kulit shadow puppet screen with a puppet of a graceful princess, on the right a golden Thai khon dance mask and ornate headdress on a stand, a single glowing lotus connecting them, theatre hall depth
scenes.cam_en: slow pan from the shadow puppet to the golden mask
scenes.beat1: lamp light behind the screen flickers and the puppet shadow sways slightly
scenes.beat2: the glowing lotus in the middle pulses softly
scenes.beat3: golden mask reflections shimmer; hold

scenes.vo: Waktu berlalu. Dasarata menua dan melihat pertanda buruk. Ia menggelar sidang besar: Rama akan jadi putra mahkota. Seluruh sidang bersorak setuju.
scenes.kamera: slow push-in toward Dasarata, with the window in frame
scenes.flow_subject: Grand assembly hall full of nobles and citizens raising hands in joyful acclaim, aged Dasarata standing at the throne announcing, through high windows a strange reddish comet in a darkening sky
scenes.cam_en: slow push-in toward Dasarata, with the window in frame
scenes.beat1: citizens raise their hands in joyful acclaim
scenes.beat2: the aged king lifts one hand to announce
scenes.beat3: the reddish comet brightens in the window while the crowd cheers; hold

scenes.vo: Sang ayah berpesan, tetaplah rendah hati dan kuasai dirimu. Rama dan Sinta diminta berpuasa semalam, beralas rumput suci. Sayang, Bharata sedang jauh.
scenes.kamera: very slow intimate push-in
scenes.flow_subject: Quiet royal chamber: aged Dasarata places his hand in blessing on Rama's head as Rama and Sinta kneel, a bed of sacred kusha grass and a small oil lamp nearby, soft night light
scenes.cam_en: very slow intimate push-in
scenes.beat1: the small lamp flame wavers
scenes.beat2: Dasarata speaks softly with his hand resting on Rama's head
scenes.beat3: Rama and Sinta bow with joined palms toward the grass bed; hold

scenes.vo: Kausalya menangis bahagia. Kepada Laksmana, Rama berkata mereka akan memimpin bersama, karena adiknya itu bagaikan dirinya sendiri. Tak ada nada sombong.
scenes.kamera: slow arc from Kausalya to Lakshmana
scenes.flow_subject: Palace shrine room with lamps and flowers: Kausalya wipes happy tears while embracing Rama's hands, Rama turns with a warm smile placing a hand on Lakshmana's shoulder
scenes.cam_en: slow arc from Kausalya to Lakshmana
scenes.beat1: lamps flicker and petals settle
scenes.beat2: Kausalya smiles through happy tears and holds Rama's hands
scenes.beat3: Rama turns and places a hand on Lakshmana's shoulder; both smile; hold

scenes.vo: Malam itu Ayodhya berhias menyambut raja muda. Tapi di balik tembok istana, sebuah rencana mulai disusun. Kalau impian terbesarmu mendadak lepas, bisakah kamu tetap tenang?
scenes.kamera: slow pull-back from the dim window to the lit city
scenes.flow_subject: Night panorama of Ayodhya decorated with thousands of lamps and festive banners being hung, in the foreground a dim palace window where two shadowy silhouettes of women whisper behind a curtain, ominous cool light
scenes.cam_en: slow pull-back from the dim window to the lit city
scenes.beat1: thousands of lamps twinkle and banners rise
scenes.beat2: the two silhouettes behind the curtain lean close and whisper
scenes.beat3: the camera widens, cool shadow creeping over the window; hold for the ending
